description: Take an open slot (a planned piece on a later day) off the calendar when it no longer makes sense. Say why in plain words; the owner reads it. A task already in the week ahead is taken off with work_cancel instead. It needs an act key.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it comes off, in plain words; the owner reads it.

name: slot_drop
title: Slot drop
